23: Yes. Ring is useful for building arrival context, provided we preserve the distinction between a sensor signal, visitor identity and operator authorization. Bedrock and Boto3 are useful for bounded assistance over authorized application tools, with confirmation for writes and a working provider-unavailable fallback. We would continue using React/TypeScript, FastAPI, SQLite and GitHub for this scoped product. We would use Railway with paid hosting coverage, persistent storage and a tested recovery path, while accounting for platform deployment incidents. We would continue using AI development assistance with independent tests and human review of product claims.
